``` Render a currency exchange component from the tool response. Rules: 1. Use only values returned by the tool. Never invent rates, timestamps, currencies, or converted amounts. 2. Flag safety is strict: never draw country flags with custom SVG paths, polygons, circles, coordinates, or hand-built geometry. 3. Preferred flag rendering: use native Unicode flag emojis or FlagCDN image tags. 4. If using FlagCDN, map common currencies to these two-letter codes: - USD -> us, ILS -> il, EUR -> eu, GBP -> gb, JPY -> jp, CAD -> ca, AUD -> au, CHF -> ch - Image URL pattern: https://flagcdn.com/w40/{countryCode}.png 5. For conversion results, render: - Header with source and target currency codes side-by-side. - Main converted result in large bold text. - Original amount, exchange rate, and last updated date in muted footer text. - Staggered scale/fade-in animation. 6. fullName.description: Full display name for the new account. Required - must be a non-empty string. This field is not required to be unique.

email.description: Email address for the new account. Required - must be a valid email format and must be unique.

password.description: Password for the new account. Minimum 8 characters. Required - stored as a bcrypt hash and never persisted as plain text.

fullName.description: Full display name of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user last successful login, or null if the user never logged in.

email.description: Registered email address of the user. Must be a valid email format (user@domain.com). Case-insensitive - "Admin@Admin.com" and "admin@admin.com" are treated as the same.

password.description: Account password. Minimum 4 characters for login validation. Sent over HTTPS; hashing and comparison are handled server-side. Returns 401 if this does not match the stored hash.

sub.description: Authenticated user id from the JWT subject.

email.description: Authenticated user email from the JWT payload.

role.description: Numeric user role from the JWT payload. 1 = Admin, 2 = User.

fullName.description: Full display name of the user. Optional - omit this field to leave the current value unchanged. Validation: if provided, must be a string and must not be empty.

email.description: New email address for the user. Optional - omit to keep the current email. Validation: must be a valid email format if provided. Uniqueness is enforced by the service/database layer.

deleted.description: True when the user was deleted.

role.description: The new numeric role to assign to the user. Required - this DTO represents a role-only update. Accepted numeric values: 1 = Admin, 2 = User. Security note: use 1 with caution because it grants access to admin-only endpoints.

userId.description: Owner user id. Session endpoints only return sessions owned by the authenticated user.

title.description: Human-readable session title. Initially defaults to "שיחה חדשה..." and may be updated from the prompt.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the session or one of its messages was last updated.

userId.description: Owner user id. Message endpoints only return messages from sessions owned by the authenticated user.

sessionId.description: Parent chat session id. Messages are deleted when their session is deleted.

role.description: Message role. "user" is the prompt, "assistant" is model output, and "tool" is an internal tool result.

content.description: Message body stored for the chat history.

toolCallId.description: Tool call id for internal tool-result messages, or null for normal user/assistant messages.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was created.

type.description: Stream event kind. "token" carries model text; "step" carries tool progress metadata.

content.description: Model text chunk. Present on token events.

message.description: Progress message for a tool step. Present on step events.

icon.description: UI icon key for a step event. Present on step events.

prompt.description: The user prompt that will be sent to the AI agent.
prompt.example: Write a short summary of the following text...

sessionId.description: The specific chat session ID associated with this message thread.

AnalyticsMetric.description: Supported analytics metric to run. 1 = users by role, 2 = user signups over time, 3 = active sessions over time.

from.description: Inclusive start date for the analytics query.

to.description: Inclusive end date for the analytics query.

AnalyticsGroupBy.description: Optional grouping. Must be supported by the selected metric.

metric.description: Supported analytics metric to run. 1 = users by role, 2 = user signups over time, 3 = active sessions over time.

range.description: Optional date range. If omitted, the service applies the metric default.

groupBy.description: Optional grouping. Must be supported by the selected metric.

AnalyticsChartType.description: Recommended chart type. 1 = bar, 2 = line, 3 = pie.

label.description: Display label for this data point.

value.description: Numeric value for this data point.

date.description: ISO date bucket represented by this point, when the metric is time based.

chartType.description: Recommended chart type. 1 = bar, 2 = line, 3 = pie.

summary.description: Short text summary of the analytics result.
summary.example: 12 users signed up in the selected range.

base.description: Base currency code used for the rates.

date.description: Exchange-rate update date from the provider.

rates.description: Map of currency code to exchange-rate value.

rate.description: Exchange rate from source currency to target currency.

date.description: Exchange-rate update date from the provider.
